Five classes T0, T1, S, M, L defined; exact membership tests stated and proved in written steps; the table lists class, defining condition, exact truth-table test and Post's name; the maximality theorem, with written proof, identifies them as exactly the maximal clones.

Completeness criterion for a set of connectives stated (part 1 for operation sets, part 2 for connective sets, positive-arity and nullary-inclusive) with a full written proof; the decision procedure applies the table; the clone diagram boxes exactly the five tabled classes, and lines 619-621 tie its boxed nodes to the table's Post names.
Active equivalent: the body and annex files are \input on the current route (main.tex:30 -> parts/p02.tex:29; main.tex:55 -> annex/p02.tex:23).

Composite: all four listed subcomponents covered (GOAL-01 to GOAL-04); the original note 'one positive basis only in v1.0' is kept as the inherited basis theorem, which lines 545-550 show is an instance of the criterion; the lattice figure is supplied.

Boolean operations of positive arity, projections, constant operations, composition, clone and generated clone are defined; the arity/constant convention sends nullary connectives to unary constant operations and excludes nullary functions from clones; the generated-clone lemma is proved.

The five obstruction classes are given and proved to be proper, pairwise incomparable clones; the criterion is proved in written steps (necessity; diagonals, constants, negation, conjunction via the algebraic normal form, then the negation-conjunction lemma, itself proved); maximality is proved.

Negative bases ({and,or}, {and,or,constants}, {neg,iff} and {neg,xor}, {->}, {and,xor}, {neg,maj}) and positive bases ({->,falsum}, {and,xor,verum}) are proved; NAND/NOR constructions of negation, conjunction and both constants are displayed and verified; NAND and NOR are proved the only singly complete binary operations; positive-arity and nullary-inclusive completeness are defined separately and separated by a proved theorem and by NAND/NOR part 3.

The clone diagram is of the two-valued clones of this section; the text identifies Post's C3, C2, D3, A1, L1 with T0, T1, S, M, L (the alternating = affine lemma is proved) and states that nothing concerns more than two truth values. Post1941 opened at two cited locators: printed p.105 (pdf 114) states the five systems and the generator criterion and the gamma/delta remarks; printed p.106 (pdf 115) names D3 self-dual, A1 [A:a], L1 alternating.
